trigger.raw_text: The MSIU team collects client feedback from clients who received treatment through the voucher system.

claims.content: The MSIU Field Office User initiates the Client Feedback entry process in the system.
The user enters the 'Voucher No' associated with the client's treatment.

The system automatically populates the following details based on the Voucher No: Client Details, Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, and Partner Treated.
The user manually enters or selects the 'Satisfaction of Treatment' (options: Not at all / Moderate / Good / Completely).
The user manually enters the 'Satisfaction of counseling'.
The user manually enters the 'Satisfaction of ensuring privacy'.
The user saves the Client Feedback record to the database.
The user should enter correct Voucher No.

The system will not allow the user to alter any information about treatment, which is populating from the system (Client Details, Details of syndromes treated, Lab Test Details, Drugs Details, Success of Treatment, Referral To Treatment, Partner Treated).
